Orders: 
- For each model with the "Officer" rule in your army, that is not currently fleeing (two Battleshock tokens), you may select one or more Orders during the Reinforcement phase, that are in effect for your army for the remaining Battle round.
- Each of the Imperial Guard's own units (= units selected from this codex OR from the Imperial Guard units in the Escalation supplement) can use one of the previously selected orders at the specified time, as long as it is within 12" of any Officer at the start of its activation. 
- An order is not consumed and any number of units can use the same order in a turn. 
- Unless otherwise stated, the effect of the order lasts until the end of the unit's activation. 
- Each unit can only benefit from a single order per turn.
- An Officer knows all orders from the list of orders.
Weapon team crews: Some units have the option to have their models form a "Heavy weapons team". These models use the "Heavy Weapon Squad" profile.
